record.name: Warden
record.description: Wardens are masters of area protection and territorial defense. They excel at protecting specific locations, establishing defensive perimeters, and using their protective abilities to safeguard entire areas from threats.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: Wardens safeguard territory and defend against threats.

progression_tree.description: Focus your defensive prowess on a specific area, granting you advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks within that area.
Establish a defensive perimeter around a location, granting allies within it advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and immunity to being charmed.

effects.value: Charmed creatures are immune to the effect.

progression_tree.description: Your presence has a calming effect on allies within the defensive perimeter, granting them advantage on Wisdom saving throws against being frightened.

effects.value: Frightened creatures are immune to the effect.

progression_tree.description: You gain control over a portion of the battlefield, allowing you to move up to your speed as a bonus action and forcing creatures within that area to make opportunity attacks against you.

effects.value: You can move up to your speed as a bonus action.
Creatures within the area have disadvantage on opportunity attacks.

progression_tree.description: You enter a state of ultimate defense, granting you a +2 bonus to Armor Class and allowing you to use your reaction to make an opportunity attack.

effects.value: You can use your reaction to make an opportunity attack.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Assumes a defensive stance with lightsaber raised, prepared to deflect incoming blaster fire.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: Emanates a calming blue aura that stabilizes nearby allies and repels hostile energies.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A Warden guardian standing vigilant on the forest moon of Endor, surrounded by towering trees and ancient ruins.
contextual_modifiers: Show Warden's lightsaber in 'guardian mode', with crystal focus and hilt emblems
Include a faint image of the Warden's loyalty oath on their cloak or armor
